## 2026 Compensation Landscape

Compensation data is the most requested resource from our clients and candidates. This comprehensive report covers salary trends across 15 major industries.

### Overall Trends

- Average salary growth: 4.2% (vs. 3.8% in 2025)
- Highest growth sectors: AI/ML (+12%), cybersecurity (+9%), healthcare (+7%)
- Lowest growth: Retail (+2%), hospitality (+3%), media (+3%)
- Remote premium: Remote roles pay 5-15% less than equivalent in-office roles in HCOL areas

### Technology & Software

| Role | Junior | Mid | Senior | Lead/Staff |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Software Engineer | $95K-$125K | $130K-$175K | $175K-$240K | $240K-$350K |
| Data Scientist | $90K-$120K | $125K-$170K | $170K-$230K | $230K-$320K |
| Product Manager | $95K-$130K | $135K-$175K | $175K-$230K | $230K-$350K |
| UX Designer | $70K-$95K | $100K-$140K | $140K-$190K | $190K-$260K |
| DevOps/SRE | $100K-$135K | $140K-$185K | $185K-$250K | $250K-$330K |

### Healthcare

| Role | Entry | Experienced | Senior | Director+ |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Registered Nurse | $65K-$80K | $80K-$100K | $95K-$120K | $120K-$160K |
| Physician | — | $220K-$300K | $280K-$400K | $350K-$600K+ |
| Health IT | $60K-$85K | $85K-$120K | $120K-$160K | $160K-$220K |
| Pharma Sales | $70K-$90K | $90K-$130K | $130K-$180K | $180K-$250K |

### Finance & Banking

| Role | Analyst | Associate | VP | Director/MD |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Investment Banking | $110K-$140K | $150K-$200K | $250K-$400K | $400K-$1M+ |
| Corporate Finance | $65K-$85K | $90K-$130K | $140K-$200K | $200K-$350K |
| Risk/Compliance | $60K-$80K | $85K-$125K | $130K-$180K | $180K-$280K |
| FinTech | $90K-$120K | $125K-$170K | $175K-$240K | $240K-$380K |

### Sales

| Role | Base | OTE | Top Performer OTE |
|---|---|---|---|
| SDR/BDR | $50K-$65K | $75K-$95K | $110K+ |
| Account Executive (SMB) | $65K-$85K | $110K-$150K | $180K+ |
| Account Executive (Enterprise) | $100K-$140K | $200K-$300K | $400K+ |
| Sales Manager | $120K-$160K | $200K-$280K | $350K+ |
| VP Sales | $180K-$250K | $350K-$500K | $700K+ |

### Key Takeaways

- AI/ML roles command the highest premiums — up 30% in 2 years
- Healthcare compensation is rising fastest at entry and mid levels due to shortages
- Sales OTE continues to outpace base salary growth
- Remote role discounts are narrowing as remote becomes standard
- Equity is becoming more common outside of Silicon Valley
